template-injection.notes: jactionlint reports untrusted contexts in expressions. zizmor also covers env indirection, github-script and more contexts.

hardcoded-container-credentials.notes: The hardcoded-container-credentials rule reports a literal password in container or services credentials.

excessive-permissions.notes: Only the opt-in missing-permissions check (no permissions block at all). Broad write scopes are not reported yet.

unpinned-uses.notes: Only the opt-in unpinned-uses check (require-commit-hash in v1), for actions and for reusable workflows.

jactionlint.message_contains: must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA
must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA
must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA

unpinned-images.notes: Only docker:// action references under unpinned-uses. container: and services: images are not checked yet.

jactionlint.message_contains: docker image must be pinned to a digest
docker image must be pinned to a digest

unsound-ternary.notes: jactionlint reports the falsy ternary idiom. zizmor 1.30.1 has no audit of this name, so this entry stays inert until a matching audit exists.

github-env.notes: Bash and sh scripts are parsed, pwsh and cmd are matched line by line. A write of an expression or variable that is trusted (github.sha, HOME, ...) is not reported, which zizmor reports in pull_request_target and workflow_run workflows. Untrusted input is also reported under other triggers.

adhoc-packages.notes: npm, yarn, pnpm, gem and bundle add in bash and sh scripts, plus bun. pwsh scripts are not parsed.

unpinned-tools.notes: The four actions zizmor knows. An input that is an expression is not reported, zizmor reports it with low confidence.

use-trusted-publishing.notes: Publish commands in bash and sh scripts and the four actions. A job with id-token: write is not reported, as in zizmor. pwsh scripts are not parsed and npm run publish is not recognized.

superfluous-actions.notes: The same table of actions. The entries zizmor reports only with its pedantic persona have their own rule, superfluous-actions-pedantic.

forbidden-uses.notes: required-actions enforces a required set of actions. zizmor's allow and deny lists are the inverse and are not covered yet.
